verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that VLP advises clients on entity formation as part of its emerging-growth practice, a counseling service for startups. Nothing shows published guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction, and the firm appears US-only (a Palo Alto contact address and no foreign offices), so the core of the story is barely touched. Missing for 10: published guidance on entity-type selection, comparison of incorporation jurisdictions, coverage of Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs German GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd, and market-specific recommendations.
